ops.title: cc-context CI red on main: pack-manifest schema drift breaks manifests/hook-tests jobs (+ codeexec race flake)
ops.description:
Pre-existing on cc-context main BEFORE the bench v14 land (CI already red on 52fb01f5; re-confirmed red on b7b2b77f with identical failures — the bench commits touch only bench/ and are exonerated by triage of run 29636653675).

Root cause: `52fb01f509 chore(pack): 10.x cleanup - pure [pack] manifest` rewrote `.claude/capt-hook.toml` and `plugin/hooks/capt-hook.toml` to the pure `[pack]`-table shape, but (a) the CI "capt-hook pack manifests move in lockstep" check still reads a top-level `["version"]` key → KeyError, and (b) the `hook-tests` job's uvx-pinned capt-hook can't load the new shape → `PackError: pack manifest ... has no [pack] section`. The same drift breaks LOCAL capt-hook runs against the cached cc-notes pack (seen 2026-07-18 in a PreCompact hook: `pack manifest ~/.cache/captain-hook/packs/cc-notes@08187680.../.claude/capt-hook.toml has no [pack] section`), so this bites every fleet session's hooks, not just CI.

Fix direction per triage: update the lockstep check to read `["pack"]["version"]` and bump the hook-tests capt-hook pin to a release that understands pure-[pack] manifests (capt-hook 10.x); or revert the manifest-shape commits until the tooling bump is ready. Separately, `test (ubuntu-latest)` / Test (race) fails in `internal/codeexec` (`TestDriverStdinEOFAnyPhase` exit 1 vs want 2) — unrelated Go sandbox subsystem, classic race-run flake pattern; rerun first, investigate only if it repeats. Likely owned by the packs-unify session that shipped capt-hook v10.0.0.

ops.text: cc-context main CI green: manifests + hook-tests jobs pass against the pure-[pack] manifest shape
local capt-hook hook runs load the cached cc-notes pack without PackError
